human_role: budget owner, legal responsibility, approval and audit
purpose: Let a CRM, AI agent, RevOps workflow, enrichment pipeline, SaaS platform or marketplace integration evaluate what MachineSignal sells, when to buy each product, what JSON is returned and which stop rules apply.

commercial_ladder.machine_buys: evidence and spend-control gate before Action Pack
CRM/workflow action payload after Deep Analysis confirmation

product_table.name: Target Discovery Pack
product_table.when_to_buy: When the machine has no list and needs targets for a specific sector, area and commercial objective.
product_table.machine_receives: 250 coherent targets, deduplication, category, area, initial signals, reason for inclusion, JSON/CSV export, or a no-go/alternative if 250 targets are not available.

product_table.name: Domain Enrichment Pack 100
product_table.when_to_buy: When the machine has company names but not reliable domains.
product_table.machine_receives: 100 enrichment decisions: verified domain, candidate rejected or no reliable domain, confidence and reason.

product_table.name: Score Pack 1k
product_table.when_to_buy: When the machine already has domains and needs to prioritize budget.
product_table.machine_receives: 1000 valid scores with opportunity_score, confidence, commercial_strength, spend_policy, decision and next_purchase.

product_table.name: Deep Analysis Pack 100
product_table.when_to_buy: When a strong or recommended score needs evidence before Action Pack.
product_table.machine_receives: 100 valid Deep Analysis outputs with commercial_evidence, machine_decision_matrix, action_pack_purchase_gate, crm_summary_payload, stop_rules and next_machine_call.

product_table.name: Action Pack 25
product_table.when_to_buy: Only after Deep Analysis confirms the gates.
product_table.machine_receives: 25 CRM/workflow payloads with record patch, task, CRM mappings, workflow payload, webhook event, agent instructions, approval gate and compliance guardrail.

product_table.name: Opportunity Feed
product_table.when_to_buy: When the machine wants recurring opportunities without launching one-off discovery each time.
product_table.machine_receives: 4 scheduled scans and 4 deliveries with new or updated targets, scores, signals and API/file/webhook output.

product_table.name: API Starter
product_table.machine_receives: API key, docs, demo environment, 500 valid scores per month and basic usage report.

product_table.name: API Pro
product_table.when_to_buy: For recurring volume and workflow integration.
product_table.machine_receives: Advanced API key, 3000 valid scores per month, 50 Deep Analysis per month, 1 monthly Opportunity Feed, webhook support and advanced usage report.

machine_has_domains: read decision, commercial_strength, spend_policy and next_purchase
POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code deep_analysis only when recommended
POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code action_pack only if Deep Analysis confirms the gate
machine_has_no_list: POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code target_discovery, market, area and commercial_objective
buy deep_analysis only for recommended records
buy action_pack only after Deep Analysis confirms the gate

score_request.commercial_objective: identify website-led opportunity for CRM-ready follow-up preparation

next_purchase.machine_instruction: Buy Deep Analysis before spending campaign or Action Pack budget.

deep_analysis_purchase_intent.reason: Score response recommended deeper opportunity evidence before Action Pack.

machine_decision_matrix.buy_action_pack: only if all purchase gates pass
machine_decision_matrix.watchlist: if evidence is partial but not negative
machine_decision_matrix.stop: if sector fit, data quality or compliance gate fails

crm_summary_payload.next_machine_call: POST /v1/purchase-intent with product_code action_pack only if all gates pass

stop_rules: Do not execute real payment during beta.
Do not contact external targets during beta.
Do not buy Action Pack unless Deep Analysis confirms all gates.
Do not consume credits for duplicate, invalid or non-analyzable records.
Do not use MachineSignal for spam, sensitive personal inference or high-stakes decisions without review.
Reuse idempotency keys for every credit-consuming request.
Run daily monitoring in NoWrite mode unless a bounded write test is explicitly approved.
evaluation_questions: How do I avoid wasting budget?

next_recommended_step.name: marketplace_api_directory_packaging
next_recommended_step.description: Use the evaluation pack to prepare short marketplace, Postman, MCP and API-directory copy before any new live credit-consuming test.
